usageNotes: Creates a terminal proxy session on the target node, returning a port, VNC ticket, UPID, and authenticated user — all required to open a WebSocket-based shell in the Proxmox web UI or a compatible VNC/xterm client. The calling user must hold Sys.Console on /nodes/{node}; using cmd values other than 'login' (e.g. 'upgrade', 'ceph_install') additionally requires the token or session to be authenticated as root@pam. The node must be online and reachable at the time of the call.

examples.summary: Open an interactive login shell on node pve1

tips: The returned 'port' is ephemeral — connect to it promptly before the termproxy worker times out.
Use the 'ticket' value as the VNC password when establishing the WebSocket connection via /nodes/{node}/vncwebsocket.
The 'upid' can be polled with the tasks API to confirm the worker is still alive.
cmd='upgrade' runs an interactive apt dist-upgrade session and requires root@pam authentication, not just Sys.Console.
